create_agent_memory: create an AgentMemory instance to store and manage game entities, players, locations, and chat messages
create_player_node: create a PlayerNode in memory with an entity ID, name, position, and look direction
add_triple_relationships: add subject-predicate-object triple relationships between memory nodes like has_property or has_fur_color
tag_and_untag_entities: tag memory entities with descriptive labels and untag them to remove associations
search_memory_with_sql: search memory using SQL-like queries with WHERE clauses, NOT, OR, AND operators on tags and properties
